local_predecessors.prior_content: Full-von-Mangoldt prime-minus-continuum measure, center retained at every additive frequency, principal zero carrier, cofactorwise completion, and zero/reducible Wright-completion gap.
A distinct Mertens-coordinate reduction showing coefficient-blind nonprincipal saving and a strip-strength principal mode.

r187_delta: Exact two-moment affine center for the frozen Vaughan tail; explicit order-four X^(-99/100) additive cutoff with field/tail-energy/cross exponents 0.46/0.92/0.96; Gevrey Mellin-difference localization of the whole completed field; finite signed far-piece counterexample.

primary_sources.title: Sums of Kloosterman sums in arithmetic progressions, and the error term in the dispersion method
primary_sources.author: Sary Drappeau
primary_sources.relevance: Signed high-conductor projector before absolute values; range N<=Q^(2/3-eta) excludes balanced R71, and the omitted low-conductor projector is not the R71 center.

primary_sources.title: Trilinear Kloosterman fractions II: subdyadic intervals and nearly balanced convolutions
primary_sources.author: Thomas Wright
primary_sources.relevance: Fixed-power subdyadic gain for a nonzero reciprocal-phase form; its proof separately treats the native determinant-zero part, but it does not supply the R71 reducible/zero-phase/center completion or completed cross-sector aggregation.

primary_sources.title: Trilinear Kloosterman fractions I: partially fixed moduli and unbalanced convolutions
primary_sources.author: Thomas Wright
primary_sources.relevance: Related nonzero-phase packet estimate; no completed low-character projector.

primary_sources.title: Trilinear forms with Kloosterman fractions
primary_sources.relevance: Foundational separated nonzero Kloosterman-fraction bound; does not include R71 completion.

primary_sources.title: Exponential sums over primes
primary_sources.authors: James Maynard, Mayank Pandey, and Maksym Radziwiłł
primary_sources.relevance: Displays an explicit N/sqrt(B) rational-major-arc term; scalar absolute-value estimate, not completed cofactor-center cancellation.

primary_sources.title: Higher uniformity of arithmetic functions in short intervals II. Almost all intervals
primary_sources.authors: Kaisa Matomaki, Maksym Radziwill, Joni Teravainen, Xuancheng Shao, and Terence Tao
primary_sources.relevance: Logarithmic control outside exceptional intervals with a sieve approximant center; wrong quantifier and completion for R71.

primary_sources.title: Bilinear forms with Kloosterman sums via quadratic characters
primary_sources.relevance: Critical short native boxes gain c^(-1/32); the exact R71 support has not been serialized into those boxes without losing completion.

primary_sources.author: Alexandru Pascadi
primary_sources.relevance: Composite-modulus packet cancellation; no continuous/residue completion or R71 all-sector theorem.
